note: The FROZEN evaluation corpus. Five held-out shards. shard_gain is the measured per-shard amplification of quantization error and readout_jitter is the measured per-shard calibration-set sensitivity of a NON-UNIFORM allocation, which is why one shard is not a measurement: the same allocation reads differently on each shard, and the spread across shards is the measurement noise band. A uniform allocation needs no calibration set and carries no jitter; the more an allocation departs from uniform, the wider the band its own reading carries, which is the whole reason a small perplexity delta here can be indistinguishable from nothing. No submission selects, reweights, reorders or subsets these shards; the verifier schedules them.
